scientific_integrity: The only new claim concerns integral orbit-space groups and products. Published nonequivariant and equivariant cover results are explicitly distinguished and credited; the exact combinatorial hypotheses are independently rechecked.
scientific_limitations: This establishes integral homology and the ordinary integral and mod-two cohomology ring of the geometric central-antipode orbit of the scale-three five-cube Rips complex; it does not establish the geometric orbit homotopy type or identify it with a Vietoris–Rips complex on a metric quotient. The cover homotopy classification and characteristic-zero representation are cited prior work. No independent audit is claimed.
title: Projective torsion in the antipodal quotient of the five-cube scale-three Rips complex
